QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] A Star is Born
QuestInfo.0: Ruthie Bea, Savanna Faia, Peri Dotts, and Amy Thys. The four singers gather in Blake's office. The atmosphere is tense, and it seems like #bBlake#k will be making a #b#ebig announcement#n#k very soon. Which candidate will sing Blake's new song, and earn the chance to become a superstar?
